#
# Web enumeration probe set for the goscans tool.
#
# Format, one probe per line, pipe separated:
#   Name|Path|optional string match|optional string match|...
# Lines starting with # are comments. A string match is only consulted when the
# server answers 200 to everything, so a match list is how a probe stays useful
# against a host with no real 404.
#
# Scope rules for anything added here:
#   - GET only, no request body, no credentials, no parameters that change state;
#   - paths that indicate exposure, not paths that exploit it;
#   - nothing that downloads a large file;
#   - keep the set small: this tool corroborates other tools rather than
#     replacing a dedicated content discovery run.
#
# Version control metadata
Git repository|/.git/config|[core]|repositoryformatversion
Git HEAD|/.git/HEAD|ref:
Subversion repository|/.svn/entries|dir
Mercurial repository|/.hg/requires|revlog
#
# Configuration and secret exposure
Environment file|/.env|APP_KEY|DB_PASSWORD|SECRET
IIS configuration|/web.config|<configuration|<system.web
Composer manifest|/composer.json|"require"
Node manifest|/package.json|"dependencies"
Docker compose file|/docker-compose.yml|services:
macOS directory index|/.DS_Store
#
# Server status and diagnostics
Apache server status|/server-status|Apache Server Status
Apache server info|/server-info|Apache Server Information
Nginx status|/nginx_status|Active connections
PHP info|/phpinfo.php|phpinfo()|PHP Version
PHP info alternate|/info.php|phpinfo()|PHP Version
Go pprof|/debug/pprof/|Types of profiles available
Prometheus metrics|/metrics|# HELP|# TYPE
ASP.NET error log|/elmah.axd|Error Log for
ASP.NET trace|/trace.axd|Application Trace
#
